package_description: Black Dior five-pan compact with a central diamond-shaped pan carrying the CD monogram and four surrounding pans embossed with four-leaf clover motifs. Each of the two Fall 2026 harmonies is paired with its own quilted couture pouch bearing clover motifs; 365 uses an ivory/ecru pouch with muted green-gray clovers, while 883 uses a pale pink pouch with light clovers.

reference_images.purpose: Dior official first-party identity anchor for 365 Charmed Green palette + matching couture pouch

collection_theme_identity: Lucky Clover is the Fall 2026 collection theme inspired by the four-leaf clover; it is not the unique official shade name of 365.

regional_availability_boundary.united_states: Official US FAQ states the 365 Charmed Green and 883 Lucky Rosewood limited editions are no longer available on dior.com; the same page may still render purchase/waitlist UI, so do not generalize beyond the US site.
regional_availability_boundary.canada: Official Canada product page remains active and displays order/waitlist UI; availability can differ by selected shade and time.
regional_availability_boundary.international: Official international product page remains published; page existence is not proof of stock in any specific country.
regional_availability_boundary.china_mainland: UNKNOWN; no Dior China first-party page was verified in this run for current stock or official Chinese shade naming.
regional_availability_boundary.global_rule: Never convert one region's availability into a global sold-out/in-stock claim.

do_not_confuse_with: 365 Charmed Green must not be renamed to Lucky Clover as its sole official shade name

regional Dior stock status is not global stock status
